name: Rank Math PRO
tagline: Rank Math PRO's solo core is compact: build a focused WordPress SEO plugin audit for user-owned sites that crawls pages, records technical signals, and exports a prioritized CSV and HTML report. A competent builder can reach a useful personal version in one sitting, while the paid product mainly wins on proprietary data, index, crawl scale.
